root_cause: Non-atomic read-then-side-effect sequencing around powerhouse_channel_decisions allowed concurrent writers to cross the external provider boundary.
prevention_rule: Every external social publish must atomically compare-and-set its canonical decision from content_ready to dispatching before the provider call; only the claim winner may cross the provider side-effect boundary. Uncertain provider outcomes require provider reconciliation before retry.

evidence.incident: Duplicate social publication from concurrent publisher runs
evidence.symptom: The same canonical social artifact could be published twice when two runs observed content_ready before either persisted provider delivery state.
evidence.safe_retry_boundary: Only before a provider side effect is proven to have occurred; otherwise reconcile external truth first.
